entities.name: Query SCP2-thiolase
observations: 484 aa; estimated molecular mass 52.5 kDa and pI 6.41.
Contains Thiolase_N (PF00108), Thiolase_C (PF02803/PF22691), and SCP2 (PF02036) domains.
Has 74.8% identity and 100% query coverage to reviewed rabbit sterol carrier protein 2 (UniProt O62742).
Strongly supports a sterol carrier protein 2/sterol carrier protein X-like fusion architecture; exact species and substrate specificity are not established from sequence alone.

entities.name: Sterol carrier protein 2
observations: Reviewed mammalian homologs are peroxisomal thiolases involved in branched-chain fatty-acid and bile-acid side-chain beta-oxidation.
The SCP2 region mediates binding/transfer of sterols, phospholipids, fatty acids, and fatty acyl-CoAs in reported mammalian homologs.
Reported localizations include peroxisomal matrix, with additional cytoplasmic, mitochondrial, and endoplasmic-reticulum evidence depending on organism and isoform.

entities.name: Peroxisomal beta-oxidation
observations: Sterol carrier protein 2 homologs participate in peroxisomal oxidation of branched-chain fatty acyl-CoAs and bile-acid intermediates.

entities.name: Intracellular lipid transport
observations: The SCP2 domain in mammalian homologs is associated with intracellular transport or binding of cholesterol, phosphatidylcholine, fatty acids, and fatty acyl-CoAs.
